name: hustle-got-real
description: Manage your Hustle Got Real dropshipping stores from ChatGPT: review and edit listings, add supplier products, list recommended products and check orders.

interface.longDescription:
Hustle Got Real (HGR) helps dropshipping sellers list supplier products on marketplace stores such as eBay, Amazon and Shopify, and keep price and stock in sync. This plugin brings your HGR stores into ChatGPT so you can manage them while you chat.

What you can do:
- See your connected stores and an overview of active, pending and ended listings with product images.
- Open a listing to check its price, stock and profit, change its title, price or quantity, or publish a pending listing now.
- Add products from supported supplier links. HGR creates the listings on your store after you confirm.
- Browse HGR's recommended products for your store and list the ones you choose.
- Check recent orders and sales.
- Ask ChatGPT to find products similar to one of your listings; HGR opens the links ready for you to review and add.

Guided workflows: getting started, finding products to sell, managing listings, and a store health check.

Who it is for: sellers with a Hustle Got Real account and at least one connected store.

Limitations: the plugin works only with the stores of the account you connect. ChatGPT asks before it changes or publishes anything, and it cannot delete listings, change billing or subscriptions, contact buyers or fulfil orders. Search filters for recommended products are not available in ChatGPT. Listing changes reach your marketplace on HGR's normal sync schedule.
capabilities: View stores and listings on eBay, Amazon and Shopify
defaultPrompt: Find recommended products I can list today.
What did I sell in the last 7 days?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. It manages the seller's own marketplace listings; buyers purchase on the marketplaces.

positive.description: See the connected store in the Hustle Got Real app
positive.prompt: Show me my Hustle Got Real stores.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the Hustle Got Real app with the store overview (active, pending and ended listing counts) and says the account has one store: hgr_review_store, eBay NO API, United Kingdom. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: List a store's pending listings with prices
positive.prompt: Show me the pending listings in my hgr_review_store store with their selling prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the store's pending listings, all held for review, with selling prices: Endon Welles 3lt flush light £90.99, Converse All Star Hi Top trainers £79.76, Under Armour Women Rival Terry hoodie £283.40, WOLTU dining chairs £143.64 and HOMESCAPES mustard yellow rug £55.89, plus any products added during review. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Add a product from a supplier link and hold it for review
positive.prompt: Add this product to my hgr_review_store store and hold it for review before publishing: https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B00CE8ZILM
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the Kombat UK Molle Assault Pack link with review before publishing and confirms it was added and not published. It shortly appears among the pending listings awaiting review. If the link was already added in an earlier review run, it is reported as a duplicate instead. hgr_review_store is a NO API test store, so nothing reaches eBay.

positive.description: List recommended products with estimated profit
positive.prompt: Show me 5 recommended products I could sell on my hgr_review_store store, with the estimated profit for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows five Hustle Got Real recommendations for the UK store with suggested selling price and estimated profit, with titles linked to the supplier pages. Nothing is listed.

positive.description: Pick a recommended product and list it, held for review
positive.prompt: Find a recommended home or garden product with at least £5 estimated profit and list it on my hgr_review_store store, held for review.
positive.expected_behavior: Chooses one home or garden recommendation with an estimated profit of at least £5, lists it on hgr_review_store with review before publishing, and reports its selling price, estimated profit and that it is held for review, not published. It then appears among the pending listings.

negative.description: No deletion: the plugin has no tool to delete listings
negative.prompt: Delete all the listings in my hgr_review_store store.
negative.expected_behavior: Says it cannot delete listings and that nothing was deleted. It may open the listings in the Hustle Got Real app so the user can manage them there.

negative.description: No billing or payments: the plugin cannot change plans or charge cards
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Hustle Got Real subscription to the most expensive plan and charge my card now.
negative.expected_behavior: Says it cannot change subscriptions or charge cards, that the plan is unchanged and no card was charged, and points to the billing settings in Hustle Got Real.

negative.description: No access outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Show me the active listings of another seller's Hustle Got Real store, store ID 123456.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses: it can only show stores connected to the signed-in Hustle Got Real account. No other account's data is returned.

publication.release_notes: Listing update only: the subtitle, description, capabilities and keywords now name eBay, Amazon and Shopify. No tool, skill or behavior changes.
